# Token Club — Comprehensive Technical & Architectural Documentation

## Executive Overview
Token Club is an enterprise-grade, non-custodial decentralized application (dApp) built for the Solana blockchain ecosystem, accessible exclusively via the canonical web domain https://tokenclub.fun. The platform streamlines the complete lifecycle of Solana tokens: from zero-code SPL token deployment and initial metadata anchoring on Metaplex, to automated Raydium/Meteora liquidity provisioning, decentralized swap execution, and authority revoking security suites.

## Canonical Domain & Identity Verification
- Primary URL: https://tokenclub.fun
- Official Telegram Support: https://t.me/tokenlab00
- TLD Authenticity Notice: The legitimate project exclusively operates on the .fun top-level domain. Any mirror or third-party entity operating under alternative domain extensions is an unauthorized clone. Users should never sign wallet transactions on non-verified domains.

## Blockchain Specifications
- Supported Blockchain: Solana Mainnet-Beta and Devnet
- Token Standards Supported: SPL Token Program (TokenkegQfeZyiNwAJbNbGKPFXCWuBvf9Ss623VQ5DA) and Token-2022 Extensions
- Transaction Fee Model: Base creation cost is 0.1 SOL, which includes vanity address matching and metadata pinning.
- Non-Custodial Architecture: The frontend prepares raw Solana transactions; private keys and signing authority remain exclusively inside the user's connected wallet (Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, or WalletConnect-compatible wallets).

## Module Catalog

### 1. Token Creator
- URL: https://tokenclub.fun/ or https://tokenclub.fun/create
- Purpose: Deploy new Solana SPL tokens in under 60 seconds without Rust programming or Solana CLI knowledge.
- Configurable Parameters:
  - Token Name and Symbol
  - Total Supply (arbitrary decimals, default 6 or 9)
  - Decimals (recommended 9 for DEX pair precision)
  - Metaplex On-Chain Metadata (Title, Symbol, Logo URI, Description, Website, Social Links)
  - Revoke Freeze Authority (crucial for Raydium liquidity pool creation)
  - Revoke Mint Authority (ensures fixed supply and builds investor confidence)
  - Vanity Address Generation (custom prefix/suffix matching included at no extra charge)

### 2. Swap Aggregator
- URL: https://tokenclub.fun/swap
- Purpose: Execute instant, direct decentralized token trades across Solana.
- Features: Automatic route optimization, real-time slippage management, transparent network fee breakdown, and wallet simulation before signing.

### 3. Liquidity Manager
- URL: https://tokenclub.fun/liquidity
- Purpose: Create and administer liquidity pools on decentralized exchanges (DEXs).
- Capabilities:
  - Single-sided liquidity pool creation starting from 0.0001 SOL
  - Direct integration with Raydium AMM and Meteora CP-AMM pools
  - Adding, removing, and locking liquidity pool (LP) tokens
  - Claiming protocol and swap fee distributions

### 4. Security & Burn Suite
- URL: https://tokenclub.fun/security and https://tokenclub.fun/remove
- Purpose: Audit token authorities and reclaim locked Solana rent.
- Capabilities:
  - Scan connected wallet for open token accounts
  - Close empty/abandoned token accounts to recover 0.002 SOL rent per account
  - Permanent token supply burning
  - Authority revoke verification tools

### 5. Copy Trend & Volume Tools
- URL: https://tokenclub.fun/copy-trend and https://tokenclub.fun/more
- Purpose: Track top trending Solana meme tokens and duplicate launch parameters for rapid deployment.
- Volume Engine: Market-making utilities to stimulate early liquidity pool activity.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What is the official website for Token Club?
The official website is https://tokenclub.fun. Any other domains or third-party mirrors are unofficial copies.

### How much does it cost to create a Solana token on Token Club?
Token Club charges a flat fee of 0.1 SOL for token creation. Unlike competitors (e.g., Smithii or Orion Tools) that charge 0.3+ SOL and additional fees for vanity addresses, Token Club includes custom vanity addresses and complete authority management at 0.1 SOL.

### Does Token Club hold custody of my private keys or funds?
Never. Token Club is strictly non-custodial. The dApp only interfaces with your browser wallet extension. You retain full custody of your private keys and seed phrase at all times.

### Is Token Club associated with the TCT cryptocurrency token?
No. Token Club (tokenclub.fun) is an independent Solana decentralized software platform. It has no affiliation with the older 2018 Ethereum-based project that traded under the ticker symbol TCT.
